alec: Quick sync — dropping the regional GPU readout for this week. TL;DR: US-W demand up ~18% WoW (model tuning + new beta), EU-W steady, APAC surging due to partner batch jobs. Need a short decision on reserving extra cards in us-west and enabling preemptible fallback in apac. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

mira: Thanks. Can you paste the per-cluster numbers? especially runway (hours) and estimated burn?

alec: Paste below. numbers are conservative (95th pct) and assume current batching.

alec: ```
region,cluster,available_gpus,current_burn_h/week,projected_burn_h/week,runway_h
us-west,cluster-a,320,28k,33.1k,8.5
us-west,cluster-b,120,10k,12.6k,9.5
eu-west,cluster-c,200,15k,15.2k,13.3
apac,cluster-d,64,4.2k,6.0k,4.5
apac,cluster-e (spot-heavy),40,2.1k,3.8k,3.2
```

chen: Noted the apac spot-heavy cluster runway is tight. Any signal on preemptible interruption rates last 7d?

alec: ops-bot pulled interrupts: 7d preempt rate apac cluster-e ~ 12% (spike on Tue), us-west spots ~6%. If we move critical low-latency traffic off spot, latency SLOs improve.

ops-bot: Forecast artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/forecasts/1976543210-gpu-forecast.csv and dashboard updated (dashboards.redwood/ops/forecast).

sofia: Cost note — extra 48 reserved A100s in us-west adds ~$42k/mo. We should compare against expected overage from burst. Do we want to commit?

alec: Proposal: 48 1-month reserve in us-west (start Thu) to smooth beta. In apac enable preemptible fallback for non-latency routed jobs + queueing backstop (30s). Also turn on prefix-KV caching for the tuning jobs to reduce token burn ~10%.

mira: Approve the apac preemptible fallback + caching change. For the us-west reserve, can we try a 72h burst credit from cloud partner first and assess?

sofia: 72h credit sounds cheaper if available. I'll ping partnerships. If not doable by EOD tomorrow, approve the 1-month reserve as fallback.

raj: Ops checklist if we reserve: 1) update autoscaler min cap 2) adjust cluster-blambda placement 3) set canary for beta traffic to cluster-a2. I can run the rollout Wed night.

alec: Good. Action items: (1) sofia to try for 72h partner credit (2) raj to prep autoscaler/placement change + canary (3) mira to flip caching and preemptible fallback (non-latency) (4) chen to monitor preempt rates and report daily.

mira: I'll flip caching and fallback during the 02:00-03:00 window UTC to minimize impact.

chen: I'll add a short liveliness probe to cluster-e job controller to avoid noisy failure loops.

sofia: pinged partnerships — awaiting reply, ETA 6h.

alec: OK, we'll reconvene in the next capacity sprint if anything changes. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
